intro: Suggestions for review. Nothing here has been implemented. Choose one option per row (or write your own) before any change is made. Status for every row: awaiting selection.

items.suggestion: Validate the supplied links before anything else. Test one Special Link per product in the Associates dashboard and compare its tracking report.
items.why: Operating Agreement section 1 requires tagged Special Links; tracking to shopnow047c-20 is not observed (FL-04, FL-05).

options.label: Test one Special Link per product, then decide
options.note: Recommended by the brief's own rule (test one link before scaling). Needs a logged-in Associates session.

options.label: Keep the supplied short links as they are
Replace all links now with Special Links
options.note: Not recommended until the test in A is done.

items.suggestion: Settle the brand name before publishing guides at scale.
items.why: The site uses the working name 'Countertop Check' (FL-14).

options.label: Keep 'Countertop Check'
options.note: Working name; check trademark availability first (not checked).

options.label: Choose a different name

items.suggestion: Decide who is named as author on each guide.
items.why: Guides currently carry the byline 'Editorial team' (FL-14). Named authors must be real people.

options.label: Keep 'Editorial team'
Add a named author with a short bio

items.suggestion: Set a fixed publishing rhythm so readers and search engines see steady updates.
items.why: Five guides exist at launch. Cadence has not been set.

options.label: One guide every two weeks
One guide per week
Pause new guides until measurement (Q-07) has data

items.suggestion: Choose where the self-hosted analytics endpoint runs. GitHub Pages cannot host it.
items.why: The click counter is wired but sends nothing until an endpoint is set (FL-17).

options.label: Small serverless function on a host you control
options.note: Needs an account and a URL.

options.label: Self-hosted analytics server on a VPS
Defer; keep counters local until measurement is needed

items.suggestion: Decide the imagery policy before adding any photo.
items.why: No product photos are used (FL-15). Program Content includes images, and their use needs checking against the IP License.

options.label: Typography only (current)
Associates-provided images only, with attribution
Commission original photography
options.note: Requires products in hand; cost not estimated.

items.suggestion: Choose which guide to publish first from the question list. Working titles only; no popularity is implied.
items.why: Search and click data do not yet exist (Q-07).

items.suggestion: Decide whether prices appear on the site at all.
items.why: No verified main-product price exists yet (FL-06). Price display rules must be checked in the Program Policies before use. The external register also mentions the Creators API for this (FL-21).

options.label: Show no prices; link to Amazon (current)
Show prices with a date and a link, once the policy check passes
Use the Amazon Creators API for prices and ratings

Replace with your own five

Add categories after the Special Link test
